statement: hypothesis promotion requires interventional tests — ablations and negative controls — not associative correlation or intrinsic self-correction
mechanism: memory.md causal-falsification rule mandates observable environment output + root-cause attribution before promotion
limitation: ablation approximates counterfactual causation; does not establish N4S causation

statement: the CRITIC ablation quantifies grounding by removing the tool (CRITIC w/o Tool) and measuring degradation
mechanism: tool-removed variant lets the model self-generate evidence; measured drop (e.g., 79.2% toxicity-probability reduction attributable to grounding) isolates the tool's causal contribution
limitation: single-domain example; transfer to retrieval unverified

statement: grounding is domain-specific: web search for facts, interpreter for code, external detector for toxicity
mechanism: each domain's verification tool observes different outputs; the ablation suite must swap per domain
limitation: retrieval-domain grounding tool not yet specified in corpus

statement: minimum retrieval-improvement test set: baseline run, ablation-with-R, engineered-irrelevant negative control, counterfactual no-fire check, root-cause attribution of regressions
mechanism: noble: derived by applying the causal-falsification rule + oracle discipline to the retrieval setting; grounded in c01-c03
limitation: number of ablation variants open; cost not measured
